command:
set -euo pipefail
CR=/workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo
git -C $CR fetch -q origin omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain:omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain || git -C $CR fetch -q origin omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf $T' EXIT; mkdir -p $T/omega; touch $T/omega/__init__.py
for f in grf_emergence.py grf_field_v2.py grf_optimizer.py; do git -C $CR show omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain:omega_deploy/grfbrain-78fde13/omega/$f > $T/omega/$f; done
PYTHONPATH=$T python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time
from omega.grf_emergence import GRFEmergenceField,GRFParameters
from omega.grf_field_v2 import GRFHomeostaticField
from omega.grf_optimizer import GRFRegimeOptimizer

def run(cls):
 p=GRFParameters(units=256,groups=8,fanout=4); f=cls(seed=0xF2A7,params=p); actions={}; t=time.monotonic()
 for _ in range(5000):
  f.step('CONSTANT_IDLE_INPUT')
  if f.causal_step%96==0:
   f.perturbation_probe('CONSTANT_IDLE_INPUT'); a=f.regulate(f.metrics()); actions[a]=actions.get(a,0)+1
 elapsed=time.monotonic()-t; s=f.snapshot(); m=s['metrics']; shape=getattr(f,'state_shape',lambda:{'mean_abs':sum(abs(x) for x in f.state)/len(f.state),'saturation_fraction':sum(abs(x)>=.92 for x in f.state)/len(f.state)})()
 return {'elapsed_s':elapsed,'metrics':m,'params':s['parameters'],'shape':shape,'actions':actions,'macro_range':[min(s['macrostate']),max(s['macrostate'])]}
v1=run(GRFEmergenceField); v2=run(GRFHomeostaticField)
f=GRFHomeostaticField(seed=0xF2A7,params=GRFParameters(units=256,groups=8,fanout=4))
for _ in range(1000):
 f.step('CONSTANT_IDLE_INPUT')
 if f.causal_step%96==0: f.perturbation_probe('CONSTANT_IDLE_INPUT'); f.regulate(f.metrics())
f.perturbation_probe('CONSTANT_IDLE_INPUT'); opt=GRFRegimeOptimizer(horizon=5,min_improvement=.005).optimize(f,'CONSTANT_IDLE_INPUT')
out={'v1':v1,'v2':v2,'optimizer':{'action':opt.action,'accepted':opt.accepted,'baseline':opt.baseline.score,'selected':opt.selected.score,'selected_name':opt.selected.name},'criteria':{'v2_less_saturated':v2['shape']['saturation_fraction']<v1['shape']['saturation_fraction'],'v2_more_metastable':v2['metrics']['metastability']>v1['metrics']['metastability'],'v2_more_switching':v2['metrics']['switching_rate']>v1['metrics']['switching_rate'],'v2_no_self_seal':v2['metrics']['layer_sealed'] is False}}
out['result']='PASS' if all(out['criteria'].values()) else 'FAIL'
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
if out['result']!='PASS': raise SystemExit(41)
PY
